verdicts.reason: A: the oversized quote-mark glyph is jammed right up against the first line of the quote. The three-line quote runs nearly from the top edge to the bottom edge and almost touches the G.M. ALLEN box, while the photo is a tiny thumbnail with a stray small glyph next to it. B: the quote, author box and thumbnail have sensible gaps and line up on the vertical centre. However, the two decorative glyphs are blown up and left floating in an empty middle area as competing focal points, the photo is too small to read, and the text is still tight against the top and bottom edges.
